name: SWAP test overlap estimation
task_prompt: Implement a Qiskit SWAP test for |psi>=RY(0.4)|0> and |phi>=RY(1.7)|0>. Use StatevectorSampler with 20000 shots and seed 31415, estimate |<psi|phi>|^2 from the ancilla-zero frequency, compare with cos^2((0.4-1.7)/2), print both, and assert absolute error below 0.025. Output code only as a self-contained Python program. Use documented public APIs, require no cloud credentials, make stochastic behavior reproducible, and include executable checks with justified tolerances.
